verdict.rationale: Gemini is a natural-language assistant at its core. First-party docs show conversational control by voice and text: Gemini Live supports free-flowing, interruptible talk, "Hey Google" works on Android, and Connected Apps let Gemini edit and manage content, summarize Gmail and create Calendar events on request. Users can also schedule recurring actions in plain language. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands reliably drive actions in connected apps, and documentation of the limits of what can be operated this way (e.g., Connected Apps unavailable in Google Messages).
